Title: Full text query in diagnostics logs for Azure Cosmos DB in general availability

Body.Content:
Improve how you diagnose query performance by viewing the query in full text within diagnostics logs for Azure Cosmos DB. Once enabled, you can view the deobfuscated query operations executed against your Azure Cosmos DB account for more detailed logging to identify performance and usage optimizations. This feature now supports full-text for the Core (SQL), API for MongoDB, Gremlin, and Cassandra APIs.

Learn more.
